{{Quote|''[&hellip;]'' a spot inspection on Calonica found that fewer than 10 percent of the 50,000 LX-2 mines, buried around the Imperial capital, contained explosive charges.|A compilation of Galactic Empire documents by Major [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]]|<ref name="ISB2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''city''' on the celestial body [[Calonica]] served as a [[Capital/Legends|capital]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was surrounded by fifty thousand buried [[LX-2 comlink mine]]s. At one point, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] remotely deactivated the [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and stole the [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charges]] from most of them.<ref name="ISB2" />
